# Phase 08: Pull Request & Merge

## Objective
Create a pull request (PR) that documents the completed work and seeks approval for merging into the main branch. Coordinate with the repository and CI/CD pipeline.

## Input
- Code in feature branch: `feature/<USER_STORY_ID>` (review-approved, verification-approved)
- All approved artifacts from phases 00-07

## Process

### 1. Prepare Feature Branch
- Ensure branch is up to date with main: `git rebase main` (if needed).
- All tests pass in CI/CD.
- No conflicts or unresolved issues.

### 2. Create Pull Request
- Title: `<USER_STORY_ID>: <Summary>`
- Example: `SCRUM-31: Empty state message reflects active filter/search`
- Description includes:
  - Link to Jira User Story
  - Summary of changes
  - Key design decisions
  - Test results summary
  - Known limitations (if any)

### 3. PR Description Template
```markdown
## Summary
Brief description of the feature.

## Jira Issue
<Link to Jira issue>

## Changes
- <Major change 1>
- <Major change 2>

## Tests
- Unit tests: X passed
- Integration tests: X passed
- Coverage: XX%

## Design Decisions
- <Decision 1 and rationale>
- <Decision 2 and rationale>

## Known Limitations
- <Limitation 1>

## Verification Checklist
- [x] Requirements met
- [x] Code reviewed and approved
- [x] Tests passing
- [x] No regressions
- [x] Documentation updated (if needed)
```

### 4. Monitor CI/CD Pipeline
- Ensure all automated checks pass.
- Address any CI/CD failures.
- Wait for approval from maintainers/code owners.

### 5. Merge
- Once approved by code owners/maintainers, merge to main.
- Delete feature branch (if policy allows).
- Confirm merge in repository.

### 6. Post-Merge Verification
- Verify PR is merged to main.
- Confirm main branch is stable (CI/CD passes).
- Document final merge commit hash.

## Output
- **Pull Request:** Created and linked in `verification.md`
- **Merge Status:** Merged to main (or awaiting approval)
- **Commit Hash:** Final merge commit recorded

## PR Location & Traceability

In verification.md, add:
```
## Pull Request
- **PR Number:** #<PR_NUMBER>
- **URL:** <Link to GitHub PR>
- **Status:** Merged / Pending Approval
- **Merge Commit:** <commit_hash>
- **Merged By:** <GitHub username>
- **Merge Date:** <timestamp>
```

## Halt Conditions
**Stop and report if:**
- Feature branch is not review-approved.
- Feature branch is not verification-approved.
- Tests fail in CI/CD.
- Conflicts exist with main branch.
- Code owners reject the PR.

**Report:**
- PR status and URL
- CI/CD failure reason (if any)
- Code review comment or rejection reason
- Recommended action

## PR Responsibilities

The PR creator/maintainer MUST:
- Provide clear PR title and description.
- Link to the Jira issue.
- Ensure CI/CD passes.
- Address code owner comments or requests.
- Finalize merge or document merge status.

The PR maintainer MUST NOT:
- Merge without required approvals.
- Merge if tests are failing.
- Add unrelated changes to the PR.

## Success Criteria
- PR is created and linked.
- PR description includes all required information.
- CI/CD checks pass.
- PR is merged to main (or clearly awaiting approval).
- Feature branch is cleaned up.
- No regression issues in main branch.

## Next Phase
**Complete** — Feature is merged and live. User Story is closed.

## Closure
Update status.md one final time:
```
Current Phase: 08: PR (Complete)
Completed Phases:
- [X] 00: Input
- [X] 01: Requirements
- [X] 02: Architecture
- [X] 03: Design Review
- [X] 04: Planning

- [X] 06: Review
- [X] 07: Verification

Blocked Phase: None
Status: CLOSED
```
